messages:
jess: We keep getting requests to surface model-level cost/latency trends inline on route pages. PMs want to spot regressions across variants quickly without opening separate model pages.
owen: Agree. My thought: add a narrow 3-col heatmap strip per-route that encodes recent token-burn, latency p95, and error-rate for each top variant. Hover shows mini-chart and exact numbers.
jess: Nice. Should the strip be per-route (stacked variants) or a single column that you expand? Concern: visual density on lists with many routes.
tara: Let's make it collapsed by default. Show an affordance: "Models (3)" pill. Expand reveals the heatmap rows. Also allow keyboard shortcut to toggle for power users.
owen: Backend: we already have per-request model tags in telemetry. We need an aggregation endpoint like /api/routes/:id/model_summary?window=24h that returns per-variant buckets. Add granularity param.
jess: Saved queries: currently they point to a single model pin. If a user saves with the expanded view open, should we persist which variants are visible and sort order? Product wants only a UI preference, not a routing change.
tara: Recommend savedquery fields: visible_models: [model_id...], model_heatmap_visible: true/false. Keep it optional to avoid breaking older clients.
owen: Authz: exposing model ids in the console is fine for most, but platform wants to hide certain internal models by default. Add a feature flag for dev preview internal-models-visible.
jess: UX detail: need clear copy when a model is partially rolled out by runtime policy. Suggest badge: "partial rollout" with tooltip: "serving policy routes only X% of traffic to this variant".
tara: Telemetry: track events model_strip.open, model_heatmap.hover, model_saved_visibility. Properties: route_id, model_ids, user_role. We'll need to add these to the analytics schema.
owen: Migration: old savedqueries with model_pin should map to visible_models=[that_model] by default. New clients ignore absent fields.
jess: Implementation plan: 1) API PR for model_summary + example payload; 2) frontend pill + collapsed strip; 3) savedquery optional fields + migration mapping; 4) telemetry events; 5) rollout behind console feature flag.
tara: Timeline: API + analytics schemav2 this week, frontend next sprint. I'll draft a short RFC and include mockups and accessibility notes for colorblind palettes.
owen: One more: provide an API param include_estimates=true to show cost-estimated token burn instead of raw tokens for orgs on aggregated billing. Keeps org-level cost view aligned.
infra-bot: deploy: telemetry-api patch deployed to staging 2024-06-13T09:15Z.
jess: Thanks. I'll coordinate with PM on the default collapsed state and collect initial user feedback in the next PM sync.
tara: Filing the RFC now -> will post link here when ready.
